title: Sales Representative - B. Add inspection to a work order line
preconds: Logged in as Sales Representative. No Work Orders access. A work order with at least one line exists.
steps:
1. Log in.
2. Open a work order and locate a line.
3. Open the three-dot menu on the line.
4. Select Add Inspection and choose a template.
expected: Step 3: Not applicable - no Work Orders access.
